outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound for placenta previa diagnosis and grading
Diagnostic accuracy of MRI for placenta previa diagnosis and grading
cohort: The study included 110 pregnant women aged 18-45 years in their third trimester with suspected placenta previa.
finding: MRI demonstrated a diagnostic accuracy of 96.4% for placenta previa, which was slightly higher than ultrasound (90.0%) but not statistically significantly different (p = 0.065).
